svg.title: One item, every judge
svg.desc: A real GSM8K item. The reference answer is 7425 and the student (Llama-3.1-8B) answers 7447.50, so the oracle says Incorrect. 18 of the 22 judges agree: 6 of 6 large judges and 12 of 16 small judges. Llama-3.2-1B, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B say Correct.
svg.text: Llama-3.1-8B answers a GSM8K question. Every judge checks it.
Judy teaches 5 dance classes, every day, on the weekdays and 8 classes on Saturday.
If each class has 15 students and she charges $15.00 per student, how much money

text.tspan: : 6 of 6 large judges, 12 of 16 small judges

svg.text: said Incorrect, as the oracle did
quick verdict (B = 10); † always reasons, so B = 8,192
